name: Public buyer contact still works with optional account login
description: Visitors may contact AutoDanini without creating an account and can find optional customer portal.
steps: Open homepage and find Moj nalog next to Cenovnik
Open private buyer inquiry and send a valid WhatsApp request without login
Open Moj nalog and verify a sign-in control appears for anonymous visitors
expected: Public inquiries remain usable anonymously. Private saved vehicle requests are not displayed unless the user authenticates.

name: Authenticated private request lifecycle
description: Signing in enables saving, listing, and deleting a private vehicle sourcing request.
steps: Open Moj nalog and sign in through the provided secure authentication popup
Enter a concrete vehicle request with type, model, destination and consent
Save and verify it appears as saved, not submitted
Reload the page and verify the same case remains
Delete the saved case and confirm it disappears after refresh
expected: A real authenticated user has persistent private cases; saved is never shown as a sale, auction bid, or automatically submitted request.

name: Account authentication and incomplete input guardrails
description: An anonymous user cannot read private requests and blank cases cannot be saved.
steps: Open the account page in a signed-out mobile browser
Verify case form and saved cases are hidden
Sign in and try to save a request without a vehicle model or consent
Sign out
expected: Server-only endpoints require auth, incomplete form is blocked, and sign out hides private cases.

name: German localization and import calculator
description: Existing cost calculator and bilingual account pages continue to work.
steps: Switch site to DE
Open Importrechner and calculate a scenario with 8000 purchase price and 700 shipping costs
Open Mein Konto
Navigate to Datenschutz
expected: Calculator works, account sign-in is localized, privacy describes saved case data and identity provider.

name: AI and auction safety guardrails
covers: AI shared quota 20 daily and 400 monthly
description: Existing AI analysis remains bounded and auctions/payments are disabled pending verification.
steps: Open AI savetnik and use demo prompt with consent
Open Auktionen page and verify no real bidding or payments are active
Open Moj nalog and inspect upcoming auction interest request type
expected: AI reports analysis or visible failure, never silently bypasses quotas; no real auction bid, checkout, or paid credits can be created.

name: Staged admin protected access
description: Only verified owner may access admin inbox; no charge or live auction
steps: Open admin signed out
Sign in using ordinary buyer account
Attempt admin API
Submit private case only with explicit consent
expected: Denied until owner allowlist set, normal buyer sees 403; submitted case creates single inbox record; no payment
